claims.claim: Link to /arena/tutorials/01-first-test/ resolves to an existing page (Tutorial 1-3 prerequisite)
The tutorial's MCP servers need Node.js installed
PromptKit ships a built-in MCP memory server
PromptKit module path is github.com/altairalabs/promptkit (cd target directory)
`go install ./runtime/mcp/servers/memory` installs the memory server
`npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` installs the filesystem MCP server
MCP servers are configured under the Arena config (spec.mcp_servers)
Arena auto-discovers the tools each configured MCP server provides
apiVersion value promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 for kind Arena
kind: Arena is a valid kind
metadata.name is a field of the Arena config
spec.prompt_configs is a list field on the Arena spec
prompt_configs entries accept an id field
prompt_configs entries accept a file field
spec.providers is a list whose entries take a file field
spec.scenarios is a list whose entries take a file field
spec.mcp_servers is a mapping keyed by server name (the tutorial uses the key memory)
Each mcp_servers entry accepts a command field
Each mcp_servers entry accepts an args list field
Each mcp_servers entry accepts an env map field
mcp-memory-server is an executable name on PATH after the Step 1 install
LOG_LEVEL is an environment variable the memory server reads, with values such as info and debug
apiVersion value promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 for kind PromptConfig
kind: PromptConfig is a valid kind
metadata.name is a field of PromptConfig
spec.task_type accepts the value assistant on PromptConfig
spec.system_template is a field of PromptConfig
The memory server exposes tools named store_memory and recall_memory
apiVersion value promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 for kind Scenario
kind: Scenario is a valid kind
metadata.name is a field of Scenario
metadata.labels is a free-form map (keys category, protocol, complexity are used)
spec.task_type accepts the value assistant on Scenario
spec.turns is a list field of Scenario
turns[].role accepts the value user
turns[].content is a field of a turn
turns[].assertions is a list field of a turn
tools_called is a valid assertion type
tools_called takes a params.tools list
Assertions accept a params.message field
content_includes is a valid assertion type
content_includes takes a params.patterns list
`promptarena run --scenario <name>` runs a scenario selected by name
--scenario matches the scenario file name tool-calling-test, not the metadata.name basic-tool-calling
`promptarena run` accepts a --verbose flag
kind: Tool is a valid kind
Tool spec.name is a field
Tool spec.description is a field
Tool spec.input_schema is a JSON schema object field
input_schema.required is a list field
Tool spec.mode accepts the value mock
Tool spec.mock_result is a free-form object field
Tool spec.mock_template is a field
The rendered mock_template output is parsed as JSON and returned as the tool result
spec.tools is a list field on the Arena spec
spec.tools entries accept a file field
tools_called with several tool names passes when each listed tool was called
tools_called checks that a tool was called, not how many times (the tutorial's Should call store_memory multiple times message)
tools_called does not check call order (the tutorial's Should call both tools in sequence message)
get_weather is a tool name the reader can expect to be defined (illustrative; used at lines 279 and 438)
query_database is a tool name (illustrative)
fetch_crypto_price is a tool name (illustrative)
read_file is a tool name (illustrative)
lookup_user and send_email are tool names (illustrative)
Verbose run prints lines of the form [TOOL CALL] store_memory({...}) and [TOOL RESPONSE] {...}
`promptarena config-inspect` is a subcommand
`promptarena config-inspect` accepts a --verbose flag
config-inspect output lists the loaded tools
mcp-memory-server reads JSON-RPC requests from stdin and answers a tools/list method
Setting LOG_LEVEL=debug in the environment changes the memory server log level
`promptarena run --scenario tool-test` runs a scenario named tool-test
run with an unknown --scenario name fails with an error
allowed_tools is a field of PromptConfig spec
A prompt reaches only the tools listed in allowed_tools; unlisted tools are not called
MCP tools are named mcp__<server>__<tool>
`promptarena run` writes results to out/results.json by default
results.json has a top-level results array
Each result entry has a tool_calls array whose items have a name field
Each tool_calls item has an arguments field
mcp-memory-server accepts a --help flag
Link to /arena/tutorials/05-ci-integration/ resolves to an existing page
Link labelled How-To: MCP Tools points to /arena/how-to/providers/use-mock-providers/, a page about mock providers
External link https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/runtime/reference/tools-mcp/ resolves
The current unpinned @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory works with Arena: its tools register with the server's own outputSchema, so structuredContent results pass
